facts.fact: Raghu says Pritam promised his loyalists grain, pay and a winter way over the mountain for their own families, shut out under the new law; he says it while bound to Pasang and his hands stay warm, so it is true. It is a different promise from Pasang's (the route-keepers freed).
Pasang reports Hari was on his feet that morning and asking after his goats; eight pairs guard the Hollow Moon huts (matches F776).

Meera tells Ila and Kunal that the spring council sits at the Shilak Cairn on Shilak's thaw day, three weeks after the Meadow Cairn's day 35 (matches F622), and that two identical signed copies must exist by then.
